name: QIDI i-Fast 0.4 nozzle
machine_start_gcode:
;T0
M82 ;absolute extrusion mode
G92 A0 B0
G28
G1 X0 Y0 Z50 F3600
M140 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single]
M104 T0 S{nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[0]}
{if is_extruder_used[1]}M104 T1 S{nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[1]}{else};M104 T1 S{nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[1]}{endif}
M190 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single]
{if is_extruder_used[1]}M109 T1 S{nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[1]}{else};M109 T1 S{nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[1]}{endif}
M109 T0 S{nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[0]}
G92 E0
G92 A0 B0
G0 X0 Y4 Z0.3 F3600
T1
G1 X330 B{is_extruder_used[1] ? 19 : 0} F2400
T0
G1 X330 Y5 F3600
G1 X5 A19 F2400
G92 A0 B0
G0 X5 F2400

M141 S0
machine_end_gcode:
M107 T-2
M140 S0
M107
M104 S0 T0
M104 S0 T1
M140 S0
;Retract the filament
G92 E1
G1 E-1 F300 Z320
G0 F3600 X320 Y0
M84
M82 ;absolute extrusion mode
M104 S0
;End of Gcode
printer_notes:
QIDI i-Fast (2021, legacy Chitu/Marlin generation) - community profile.
Derived from OrcaSlicer's stock 'Qidi X-Max 0.4 nozzle' (AGPL-3.0; upstream Bambu Studio / PrusaSlicer). Geometry and dual-extruder configuration from QIDI's own published PrusaSlicer profile for this machine (PrusaSlicer_fast.ini; see reference/qidi-profiles.md); start, end and tool-change G-code from QIDI Print reference exports (see reference/extracted-gcode.md).
Network printing is intentionally unconfigured: the i-Fast uses a proprietary UDP protocol OrcaSlicer does not support. Extruder offsets are handled in firmware and MUST stay zero here. Head auto-lift on tool change is firmware behaviour.
See TODO.md for every value still needing verification on the machine.
